---
title: "Deuteronomy"
---

# Deuteronomy

::: {.book-summary}
## Book Summary Insight

Deuteronomy records Moses' final speeches, urging Israel to remember God's faithfulness and renew their covenant before entering the Promised Land. The book teaches that wholehearted love for God is demonstrated through faithful obedience.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 1

<div class="key-verse">Deuteronomy 1:31</div>

<div class="identifier">The LORD carried thee</div>

### Why This Verse

Summary of God's care

### Chapter Insight

This chapter reviews Israel's journey from Horeb and their failure at Kadesh-barnea. The key verse highlights how unbelief delayed God's promises.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 2

<div class="key-verse">Deuteronomy 2:7</div>

<div class="identifier">The LORD thy God hath been with thee</div>

### Why This Verse

Wilderness provision

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts Israel's wilderness travels and victories east of the Jordan. The key verse emphasizes God's sovereign guidance and provision.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 3

<div class="key-verse">Deuteronomy 3:22</div>

<div class="identifier">The LORD shall fight for you</div>

### Why This Verse

Encouragement before conquest

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records victories over Og and preparations to enter Canaan. The key verse reminds Israel that God fights for His people.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 4

<div class="key-verse">Deuteronomy 4:29</div>

<div class="identifier">Seek the LORD and find Him</div>

### Why This Verse

Foundational promise of repentance

### Chapter Insight

This chapter calls Israel to remember and obey God's laws. The key verse emphasizes the unique privilege of having God near to His people.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 5

<div class="key-verse">Deuteronomy 5:7</div>

<div class="identifier">Thou shalt have no other gods</div>

### Why This Verse

Restatement of the Ten Commandments

### Chapter Insight

This chapter restates the Ten Commandments for the new generation. The key verse underscores covenant obedience as the foundation of national life.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 6

<div class="key-verse">Deuteronomy 6:4</div>

<div class="identifier">Hear, O Israel: The LORD is one</div>

### Why This Verse

The Shema; among Judaism's most important verses

### Chapter Insight

This chapter teaches wholehearted devotion to God. The key verse presents the Great Commandment as the heart of covenant faithfulness.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 7

<div class="key-verse">Deuteronomy 7:9</div>

<div class="identifier">Know that the LORD is God</div>

### Why This Verse

Covenant faithfulness

### Chapter Insight

This chapter explains Israel's calling as God's chosen people. The key verse highlights God's love and covenant faithfulness rather than Israel's merit.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 8

<div class="key-verse">Deuteronomy 8:3</div>

<div class="identifier">Man shall not live by bread alone</div>

### Why This Verse

Quoted by Jesus during temptation

### Chapter Insight

This chapter warns against forgetting God in times of prosperity. The key verse teaches dependence upon God's word above material provision.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 9

<div class="key-verse">Deuteronomy 9:5</div>

<div class="identifier">Not for thy righteousness</div>

### Why This Verse

Grace over merit

### Chapter Insight

This chapter reminds Israel that victory comes from God's grace, not their righteousness. The key verse warns against spiritual pride.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 10

<div class="key-verse">Deuteronomy 10:12</div>

<div class="identifier">What doth the LORD require of thee</div>

### Why This Verse

Summary of covenant duty

### Chapter Insight

This chapter emphasizes God's mercy and His desire for heartfelt obedience. The key verse summarizes God's requirements for His people.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 11

<div class="key-verse">Deuteronomy 11:26</div>

<div class="identifier">I set before you blessing and curse</div>

### Why This Verse

Central covenant choice

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contrasts the blessings of obedience with the consequences of disobedience. The key verse urges Israel to choose God's blessing through faithfulness.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 12

<div class="key-verse">Deuteronomy 12:5</div>

<div class="identifier">The place the LORD shall choose</div>

### Why This Verse

Worship centralization

### Chapter Insight

This chapter centralizes worship in the place God chooses. The key verse stresses worship according to God's instructions rather than personal preference.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 13

<div class="key-verse">Deuteronomy 13:4</div>

<div class="identifier">Walk after the LORD your God</div>

### Why This Verse

Loyalty to God

### Chapter Insight

This chapter warns against false prophets and idolatry. The key verse teaches loyalty to God above all other influences.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 14

<div class="key-verse">Deuteronomy 14:2</div>

<div class="identifier">A holy people unto the LORD</div>

### Why This Verse

Covenant identity

### Chapter Insight

This chapter distinguishes Israel as a holy people. The key verse connects everyday conduct with covenant identity.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 15

<div class="key-verse">Deuteronomy 15:11</div>

<div class="identifier">The poor shall never cease from the land</div>

### Why This Verse

Frequently quoted social teaching

### Chapter Insight

This chapter outlines laws regarding debt release and generosity. The key verse reveals God's concern for compassion toward the needy.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 16

<div class="key-verse">Deuteronomy 16:20</div>

<div class="identifier">Justice, justice shalt thou pursue</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the most cited OT justice texts

### Chapter Insight

This chapter reviews Israel's major feasts and principles of justice. The key verse highlights joyful worship and remembrance of God's redemption.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 17

<div class="key-verse">Deuteronomy 17:20</div>

<div class="identifier">That his heart be not lifted up</div>

### Why This Verse

Kingship under God's law

### Chapter Insight

This chapter establishes guidelines for judges, priests, and kings. The key verse emphasizes submission to God's authority through appointed leadership.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 18

<div class="key-verse">Deuteronomy 18:15</div>

<div class="identifier">A prophet like unto me</div>

### Why This Verse

Major messianic passage

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes God's provision of prophets and warns against pagan practices. The key verse promises a future prophet whom God's people must hear.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 19

<div class="key-verse">Deuteronomy 19:15</div>

<div class="identifier">Two or three witnesses</div>

### Why This Verse

Frequently cited legal principle

### Chapter Insight

This chapter establishes cities of refuge and principles of justice. The key verse demonstrates God's concern for both mercy and fairness.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 20

<div class="key-verse">Deuteronomy 20:4</div>

<div class="identifier">The LORD goes with you to fight</div>

### Why This Verse

Divine warfare promise

### Chapter Insight

This chapter provides laws for warfare. The key verse reminds Israel that victory comes from God's presence rather than military strength.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 21

<div class="key-verse">Deuteronomy 21:23</div>

<div class="identifier">Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree</div>

### Why This Verse

Quoted by Paul in Galatians

### Chapter Insight

This chapter addresses various social and legal responsibilities. The key verse emphasizes justice and responsibility within the covenant community.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 22

<div class="key-verse">Deuteronomy 22:4</div>

<div class="identifier">Thou shalt not hide thyself</div>

### Why This Verse

Responsibility toward neighbor

### Chapter Insight

This chapter applies covenant principles to everyday life. The key verse illustrates God's concern for practical righteousness.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 23

<div class="key-verse">Deuteronomy 23:14</div>

<div class="identifier">The LORD walks in the midst of thy camp</div>

### Why This Verse

Divine presence and holiness

### Chapter Insight

This chapter regulates holiness within the camp and community. The key verse emphasizes that God's presence requires purity among His people.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 24

<div class="key-verse">Deuteronomy 24:19</div>

<div class="identifier">Leave some for the stranger, fatherless, widow</div>

### Why This Verse

Cornerstone of biblical charity

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains laws protecting marriage, workers, and the vulnerable. The key verse highlights God's concern for compassion and fairness.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 25

<div class="key-verse">Deuteronomy 25:4</div>

<div class="identifier">Thou shalt not muzzle the ox</div>

### Why This Verse

Quoted by Paul regarding ministry

### Chapter Insight

This chapter continues laws regarding justice and community life. The key verse stresses integrity and honesty in all dealings.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 26

<div class="key-verse">Deuteronomy 26:18</div>

<div class="identifier">A peculiar people unto Himself</div>

### Why This Verse

Covenant declaration

### Chapter Insight

This chapter prescribes offerings of firstfruits and tithes. The key verse encourages gratitude by remembering God's faithfulness.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 27

<div class="key-verse">Deuteronomy 27:26</div>

<div class="identifier">Cursed is he that confirmeth not this law</div>

### Why This Verse

Quoted in Galatians

### Chapter Insight

This chapter instructs Israel to renew the covenant upon entering Canaan. The key verse emphasizes public commitment to God's law.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 28

<div class="key-verse">Deuteronomy 28:1</div>

<div class="identifier">If thou shalt diligently obey</div>

### Why This Verse

Opening of blessings and curses

### Chapter Insight

This chapter presents blessings for obedience and curses for disobedience. The key verse summarizes the consequences of covenant choices.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 29

<div class="key-verse">Deuteronomy 29:29</div>

<div class="identifier">Secret things belong unto the LORD</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the most quoted verses in Deuteronomy

### Chapter Insight

This chapter renews the covenant with a new generation. The key verse stresses personal responsibility before God.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 30

<div class="key-verse">Deuteronomy 30:19</div>

<div class="identifier">Choose life</div>

### Why This Verse

Famous covenant appeal

### Chapter Insight

This chapter calls Israel to choose life through obedience and faith. The key verse presents one of Scripture's clearest invitations to choose God's way.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 31

<div class="key-verse">Deuteronomy 31:6</div>

<div class="identifier">Be strong and of good courage</div>

### Why This Verse

Widely quoted encouragement

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Moses' final instructions and Joshua's commissioning. The key verse encourages courage through God's abiding presence.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 32

<div class="key-verse">Deuteronomy 32:4</div>

<div class="identifier">He is the Rock, His work is perfect</div>

### Why This Verse

Foundational statement about God

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains the Song of Moses. The key verse declares God's perfect faithfulness and justice.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 33

<div class="key-verse">Deuteronomy 33:27</div>

<div class="identifier">The eternal God is thy refuge</div>

### Why This Verse

Beloved promise verse

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Moses' blessings upon the tribes. The key verse celebrates the security and blessing found in God alone.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 34

<div class="key-verse">Deuteronomy 34:10</div>

<div class="identifier">No prophet arose like Moses</div>

### Why This Verse

Conclusion of Moses' life

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts Moses' death and Joshua's succession. The key verse honors Moses' unique role as God's servant and prophet.
:::
